title: Captured local acoustic jet calculation before the completed-kernel implementation
statement: The captured1500 producer statement and exact local calculation report a jet map of rank8 on the12-dimensional admissible cubic space, with kernel exactly the four translation cubics. Two binary-cubic charges describe the missing limiting data at the two singular acoustic directions. At this stage the producer is adding these terms and checking the completed allocation problem. This v1 is first published alongside the later captured implementation stage, not represented as an earlier release.
